title: 第三章 花菱妹子第四章 开辟武脉
content_zh:
回到家，天色已暗了下来。
破败的两间茅草屋，墙壁是用木头夹杂黄泥堆砌而成，推开门，家里一贫如洗，除了桌子，凳子，一张旧床和灶台外，再没有别的东西。
一个穿着粗布衣衫的清秀少女坐在凳子上，愁云满面的样子。
她身上的青色短衣洗得几乎看不出什么颜色了，两只打着补丁的裤腿卷得老高，露出一截洁白如藕段的小腿，脚腕上还沾着新鲜的泥点子。
小姑娘身段窈窕轻灵，细细的小蛮腰柔韧有力，脸蛋儿像是春天里映日的海棠，白皙中透着醉人的酡红，尚没有完全长开的胸脯微微翘起，使青色短衣挺起一个小小的弧度，看样子纵然营养不良，在某些方面，发育的依旧形势喜人。
这就是自己的妹子花菱。
犹如扑面而来的清风细雨，让叶枫有种用山间清泉洗了一把脸的感觉，看到的第一眼，就让他升腾起满满的亲切感。
花菱是父亲当年捡来的，没有什么血缘，叶枫不由着重“回味”
了一下这句话，心神激荡，就在这时候，他听到少女清脆的声音，像是山间百灵唱歌。
“哥哥！”
露出喜色的少女快步向叶枫奔来。
“哥哥，你回来了。”
花菱一阵风一样跑到了叶枫身前，随即伸手抱了上来。
一时间，少女的清香充满鼻间，配合那柔软身段，给人一种旖旎感觉，低头的叶枫看到，花菱清绝脸上那一双大眼睛，有点儿发红。
“哥哥，你回来就好，担心死菱儿了，听打铁的大牛哥说，你被赵执事叫去，整整一天都没有回来，菱儿正要出门去找，可是天黑的很快……”
紧紧抱着叶枫，花菱尖尖的下巴抵着叶枫的肩膀，眼睛又红了。
这些年来，花菱亲眼见过叶枫受欺辱，吃苦头，但从没有这一次那样让她担心过，似乎冥冥中有种错觉，她很有一种哥哥回不来了的感觉，而随着天色变黑，这种感觉让花菱越来越是强烈。
所以见到叶枫的身影，花菱的双手很用力，几乎用尽了全身的力气，仿佛要将叶枫揉进自己的身体一般。
有一种麻酥酥的温润感觉，叶枫身子僵硬，表情精彩万分。
幸好抱了抱后，花菱就放开了他。

“哥哥，一整天都没有吃东西，你肯定饿了吧，我们吃饭，菱儿给你剩饭。”
近乎是强行一般将叶枫按在木凳上，花菱动作麻利的打开灶台，很快，大半碗米粥，两个不知名的野果，还有一碗清水煮的野菜摆上了木桌。
饿了一整天，叶枫早就前胸贴后背了，可看到桌上的饭菜，他却觉得难以动嘴，不是什么平时吃惯大鱼大肉，对这种米粥野菜难以下咽，而是心中真正感到伤感。
难怪身体如此瘦弱单薄。
“就……吃这个？”
两人都处在长身体的年纪，光吃这样的东西，营养怎么够？
花菱懂事的点点头，顺手将唯一的米粥推向叶枫，自己却抓起一个青皮果子啃着。
就这一碗熬粥的米还是下午铁匠赵大牛送来的，兄妹俩在赵家庄是杂役都不如的外人，加上叶枫身为男子却未能觉醒武脉，受尽欺凌，这两年向来有一顿没一顿的。
“菱儿，你吃吧，哥哥，呃，刚才吃过了，赵执事请的客，有酒有肉，可惜哥哥没给你带一些回来……”
叶枫将米粥推回给花菱。
content_en:
When I got home, it was getting dark.
It was a dilapidated two-room thatched house with walls made of wood mixed with yellow mud. When the door was opened, the family was destitute. Apart from a table, stools, an old bed and a stove, there was nothing else.
A delicate girl wearing coarse clothes sat on a stool with a sad look on her face.
The green shorts on her body were so washed that the color was almost invisible, and her two patched trouser legs were rolled up high, revealing a calf as white as a lotus root, with fresh mud specks on her ankles.
The little girl has a slender figure, a slender waist that is flexible and strong, her face is like a begonia reflected in the sun in spring, and her fair skin is tinged with an intoxicating blush. Her breasts, which have not yet fully grown, are slightly raised, causing her blue shorts to stand up in a small arc. It seems that even though she is malnourished, she is still developing in some respects.
This is my sister Hanabishi.
Like the gentle breeze and drizzle hitting his face, Ye Feng felt as if he had washed his face with a mountain spring. The first sight of it made him feel full of intimacy.
Hua Ling was picked up by his father back then and had no blood connection. Ye Feng couldn't help but emphasize "aftertaste"
After hearing these words, his mind was agitated. At this moment, he heard the girl's clear voice, like a lark singing in the mountains.
"Brother!"
The happy girl ran towards Ye Feng quickly.
"Brother, you are back."
Hua Ling ran to Ye Feng like a gust of wind, and then reached out to hug him.
For a moment, the girl's fragrance filled the nose, and together with the soft figure, it gave people a charming feeling. Ye Feng, who lowered his head, saw that the big eyes on Hua Ling Qingjue's face were a little red.
"Brother, it's good that you come back. I'm worried about Ling'er. I heard from the blacksmith brother Da Niu that you were called by Deacon Zhao and didn't come back for a whole day. Ling'er was about to go out to look for it, but it got dark very quickly..."
Hualing hugged Ye Feng tightly, Hualing's pointed chin pressed against Ye Feng's shoulder, and her eyes turned red again.
Over the years, Hua Ling had seen Ye Feng being bullied and suffered, but it had never worried her as much as this time. She seemed to have a misunderstanding, and she had a feeling that her brother would never come back. As the sky turned dark, this feeling made Hua Ling more and more intense.
So seeing Ye Feng's figure, Hua Ling's hands were very strong, almost using up all his strength, as if he wanted to rub Ye Feng into his body.
There was a numb and warm feeling. Ye Feng's body was stiff and his expression was wonderful.
Fortunately, after hugging him, Hua Ling let him go.
"Brother, you haven't eaten all day. You must be hungry. Let's eat and Ling'er will give you the leftovers."
Pressing Ye Feng down on the wooden bench almost forcefully, Hua Ling quickly opened the stove. Soon, half a bowl of rice porridge, two unknown wild fruits, and a bowl of boiled wild vegetables were placed on the wooden table.
After being hungry all day long, Ye Feng's chest was pressed against his back, but when he saw the food on the table, he felt it was difficult to move his mouth. It was not that he was used to eating big fish and meat, so he couldn't swallow this kind of rice porridge and wild vegetables, but he felt really sad in his heart.
No wonder the body is so thin and thin.
"Just...eat this?"
Both of them are at a growing age. How can they get enough nutrition just by eating something like this?
Hua Ling nodded sensibly and pushed the only rice porridge to Ye Feng, but he grabbed a green-skinned fruit and gnawed it.
This bowl of rice for making porridge was sent by the blacksmith Zhao Daniu in the afternoon. The brother and sister were outsiders in Zhaojiazhuang who were inferior to the handymen. In addition, Ye Feng, as a man, failed to awaken his martial arts and was bullied. He had never had a meal in the past two years.
"Ling'er, you can eat. Brother, uh, I just ate. The guests invited by Deacon Zhao included wine and meat. It's a pity that brother didn't bring some back for you..."
Ye Feng pushed the rice porridge back to Hua Ling.
